# Refusal codes

A refusal is a JSON object `{"code", "sentence", "correlationId"}`. The `code` of a refusal the door answers is one of the 47 below and is stable. The `sentence` is for people and may be reworded. The `correlationId` names the call in the door's log.

Every `503` answer carries `Retry-After: 1`: retry the same request after a second. Every other refusal is final for the request as sent, except `claim/agreement-first`, where the same claim can be sent again once `status` shows the agreement `recorded`, and `settle/not-settling` answering a `declined` report sent before the payment is claimed, where the same report can be sent again once it is claimed.

The same codes are exported as `REFUSALS` from `@integraledger/agentic-connectors`, each with its status.

The HTTP runtime in front of the door answers a few codes of its own, in the same shape: they are listed under [the runtime in front of the door](#the-runtime-in-front-of-the-door).

## 400

The body is not the operation's JSON object.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| <a id="doormalformed"></a>`door/malformed` | The body is not the operation's JSON object: it is not JSON, it is not an object, or a member is missing, has the wrong type, or is not in the schema. |

## 401

No valid seller credential.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| <a id="doorunauthenticated"></a>`door/unauthenticated` | The request carries no seller credential, or one the door does not know. The answer carries `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="seller-door"`. |

## 403

The request carries an Origin header; the door serves servers only.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| <a id="doorbrowser-origin"></a>`door/browser-origin` | The request carries an `Origin` header. The door serves servers only; call it from your backend. |

## 404

Nothing known by that name for this tenant.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| <a id="doornot-found"></a>`door/not-found` | Nothing is known by that name for this tenant: no such path, or no record with that ATR hash. |
| <a id="doorresource-unknown"></a>`door/resource-unknown` | The `resource` names no resource declared for this tenant. |
| <a id="claimunknown"></a>`claim/unknown` | No record matches the hash the payment carries. |

## 405

The request's method is one this path does not serve.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| <a id="doormethod"></a>`door/method` | The path is served, but not with this method. |

## 409

The record is in a state that does not allow this.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| <a id="issuemint-request-reused"></a>`issue/mint-request-reused` | This `mintRequestId` was issued for other offers or another request. A changed checkout needs a new id. |
| <a id="issuemint-request-lapsed"></a>`issue/mint-request-lapsed` | This `mintRequestId`'s record has lapsed. Append `:<n>` with a new `n` and issue again. |
| <a id="claimin-progress"></a>`claim/in-progress` | This ATR's payment is already claimed. On a retry of the same presentation, the first attempt won. |
| <a id="claimpaid"></a>`claim/paid` | This ATR is already paid. |
| <a id="claimnot-this-request"></a>`claim/not-this-request` | The payment is not for the options and request this ATR was issued for. |
| <a id="claimchannel-open"></a>`claim/channel-open` | This channel is already open under an ATR. Serve its later requests yourself, and never claim them. |
| <a id="claimchannel-not-open"></a>`claim/channel-not-open` | No opening of this channel was claimed. Claim the opening first. |
| <a id="claimagreement-first"></a>`claim/agreement-first` | The record needs the agreement step, and the agreement payment is not recorded yet. Claim this payment once it is. |
| <a id="claiminstrument-claimed"></a>`claim/instrument-claimed` | This payment instrument is already claimed for another record. |
| <a id="reportpairing-mismatch"></a>`report/pairing-mismatch` | The report names a pairing other than the record's (the claimed pairing, or before a claim one the record offered), or `chosen` is not an option this record issued, with its `request` where the options are tied to the request. |
| <a id="settleother-reference"></a>`settle/other-reference` | This record was settled with another reference. |
| <a id="settlenot-settling"></a>`settle/not-settling` | The record is not in a state that allows this report. |

## 410

The challenge has lapsed.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| <a id="claimlapsed"></a>`claim/lapsed` | The challenge for this ATR has lapsed. |

## 413

The body is larger than this operation accepts.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| <a id="doortoo-large"></a>`door/too-large` | The body is larger than the operation accepts. |

## 415

The body is not application/json.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| <a id="doormedia-type"></a>`door/media-type` | The body is not sent as `application/json`. |

## 422

The request cannot be served as sent.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| <a id="doorrequest-required"></a>`door/request-required` | The offer or claim is on an x402 surface and carries no `request` commitment. |
| <a id="doorchosen-required"></a>`door/chosen-required` | The report is for a record with no claim, and needs `chosen`: the option the payment paid, as issued. |
| <a id="doorreference-required"></a>`door/reference-required` | The report needs a `reference` of 1 to 256 characters with no control characters. |
| <a id="doorreceipt-required"></a>`door/receipt-required` | The paid report is for a confirm-only channel pairing, and needs the `receipt` its opening answered. |
| <a id="issueinput-bounds"></a>`issue/input-bounds` | The request is outside the bounds the door accepts (for example more than 16 offers or 56 content slots). |
| <a id="issuepairing-not-served"></a>`issue/pairing-not-served` | An offer names a pairing this resource does not serve. |
| <a id="issueoffer-refused"></a>`issue/offer-refused` | An offer cannot be placed by its pairing: the offer is on a network the door does not serve for this tenant, its pairing is not its option's own, or the pairing cannot place the hash in that option. The sentence names the pairing and the code of the cause. |
| <a id="issuemixed-protocols"></a>`issue/mixed-protocols` | The offers name pairings of more than one protocol. One `issue` serves one protocol. |
| <a id="coreslot-name"></a>`core/slot-name` | A content slot's name is not allowed: it must match `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}$`. |
| <a id="coreslot-reserved"></a>`core/slot-reserved` | A content slot uses a name the ATR reserves (`atrVersion`, `id`, or the binding's slot). |
| <a id="coreslot-duplicate"></a>`core/slot-duplicate` | Two content slots have the same name. |
| <a id="corecontent-not-json"></a>`core/content-not-json` | A content slot's bytes are not exactly one JSON value (RFC 8259), or nest more than 64 levels. |
| <a id="corebinding-not-json"></a>`core/binding-not-json` | An offer cannot be recorded as JSON. |
| <a id="coretoo-large"></a>`core/too-large` | The ATR would be larger than the size the door allows. |
| <a id="claimpairing-unknown"></a>`claim/pairing-unknown` | The pairing is not one this payment or the chosen option offers. |
| <a id="claimnot-bound"></a>`claim/not-bound` | The payment carries no ATR hash the door can read in the pairing's field. |
| <a id="claimnothing-to-check"></a>`claim/nothing-to-check` | The pairing carries nothing the buyer signs. Report the payment instead. |

## 503

Not available now; retry after one second.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| <a id="issuedeadline"></a>`issue/deadline` | The ATR was not ready in time. Retry with the same `mintRequestId`. |
| <a id="issuecontributor-unavailable"></a>`issue/contributor-unavailable` | Not available now; retry after one second. |
| <a id="issuestorage-unavailable"></a>`issue/storage-unavailable` | The ATR could not be written to the seller's storage, so no challenge may go out. Retry shortly. |
| <a id="issuestore-unavailable"></a>`issue/store-unavailable` | Not available now; retry after one second. |
| <a id="issuecapacity"></a>`issue/capacity` | Not available now; retry after one second. |
| <a id="claimstore-unavailable"></a>`claim/store-unavailable` | Not available now; retry after one second. |
| <a id="claimread-unavailable"></a>`claim/read-unavailable` | The landed payment could not be read on the rail yet. Retry shortly. |
| <a id="settlestore-unavailable"></a>`settle/store-unavailable` | Not available now; retry after one second. |

## The runtime in front of the door

A refusal the HTTP runtime in front of the door answers itself, in the same shape as the door's: before the door reads the request, or where the door gives no answer. Its codes are the runtime's own and are not in the door's closed refusal table.

| Code | Status | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="bad-request"></a>`bad-request` | 400, 431 | The request could not be read: it is not well-formed HTTP/1.1, or its target or its `Host` header is not one the runtime serves (400), or its header block is larger than the runtime reads (431). |
| <a id="method-not-allowed"></a>`method-not-allowed` | 405 | The method is `CONNECT` or `TRACE`, which the runtime serves on no path. |
| <a id="request-timeout"></a>`request-timeout` | 408 | The request did not arrive in full in time. |
| <a id="body-too-large"></a>`body-too-large` | 413 | The body is larger than the runtime accepts for any request; the door never read it. |
| <a id="fault"></a>`fault` | 500 | The request could not be served. Quote the `correlationId` to the door's operator. |
| <a id="at-capacity"></a>`at-capacity` | 503 | The runtime is at capacity; retry after one second. |
